Markdown File to join all pig studies and store in a "clean" phyloseq object.


```{r}
# Load Libraries

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(phyloseq)
library(data.table)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
#  the repository root

repo_root <- "/home/brymoore/wsg_gtdb_tax/pig_microbiome"
```

```{r}
# path roots for  seq table files

seqtab_files <- list.files(
  path = repo_root,
  pattern = "^sequence_table\\.csv$",
  full.names = T,
  recursive = T
)


# print the count and file paths

cat(sprintf("Found %d seqtab files\n", length(seqtab_files)))
    for (f in seqtab_files) {print(f)}
```


```{r}
# Pre-map taxonomy files by study folder
all_tax_files <- list.files(
  path = repo_root, 
  pattern = "(taxid).*\\.(csv|tsv|txt)$", 
  full.names = TRUE, 
  recursive = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)
```



```{r}
# Build a lookup named vector: folder_path -> tax_file_path
tax_map <- setNames(all_tax_files, dirname(all_tax_files))

cat(sprintf("Found %d sequence tables and %d taxonomy files.\n", 
            length(seqtab_files), length(all_tax_files)))
```

```{r}
#Fast Processing Loop using data.table
master_list <- map(seqtab_files, function(current_file) {
  
  study_folder <- dirname(current_file)
  study_id <- basename(study_folder)
  
  # Check if a matching taxonomy file exists in tax_map
  tax_path <- tax_map[[study_folder]]
  if (is.null(tax_path) || length(tax_path) == 0) {
    message(sprintf("Skipping %s: No taxonomy file found.", study_id))
    return(NULL)
  }
  # --- Fast Read Sequence Count Matrix ---
  # fread reads CSVs up to 20x faster than read.csv
  seqtab <- fread(current_file, header = TRUE)
  
  # Rename first column to 'sample'
  setnames(seqtab, 1, "sample")
  
  # --- Fast In-Place Melt (Reshape to Long) ---
  long_dt <- melt(
    seqtab, 
    id.vars = "sample", 
    variable.name = "sequence", 
    value.name = "count",
    variable.factor = FALSE
  )
  
  # --- Filter Zeros Immediately ---
  long_dt <- long_dt[count > 0]
  
  # --- Fast Read Taxonomy Table ---
  taxtab <- fread(tax_path[[1]], header = TRUE)
  setnames(taxtab, 1, "sequence")
  
  # Ensure join keys are character vectors
  long_dt[, sequence := as.character(sequence)]
  taxtab[, sequence := as.character(sequence)]
  
  # --- Fast C-Optimized Keyed Left Join ---
  merged_dt <- taxtab[long_dt, on = "sequence"]
  merged_dt[, study := study_id]
  
  return(merged_dt)
})
  
```


```{r}
#Fast Bind into a single data.table
master_df <- rbindlist(master_list, fill = TRUE)

```


```{r}
# Convert to standard data.frame or tibble if needed
master_df <- as.data.frame(master_df)

```

```{r}
head(master_df)
```

## Add the ASV representative name

```{r}
master_df <- master_df %>% 
  group_by(study) %>% 
  mutate(asv_id = paste0(study, "_ASV", dense_rank(sequence))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  relocate(asv_id, .after = study) # Places asv_id right after study

head(master_df)

```

### Join all the metadata tables

```{r}

#repo_root <- "/home/brymoore/wsg_gtdb_tax/pig_microbiome"

# 1. Find all SraRunTable.csv files
metadata_files <- list.files(
  path = repo_root,
  pattern = "(?i)sraruntable.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

cat(sprintf("Found %d SraRunTable files.\n", length(metadata_files)))

# 2. Read and combine metadata using data.table (forcing character columns)
all_metadata <- rbindlist(lapply(metadata_files, function(file) {
  df <- fread(file, header = TRUE, colClasses = "character")
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    warning(sprintf("Skipping empty metadata file in: %s", basename(dirname(file))))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df[, study := basename(dirname(file))]
  return(df)
}), fill = TRUE)

# Convert to standard data frame
all_metadata <- as.data.frame(all_metadata)

# --- CRITICAL FIX: Make sure all column names are unique ---
colnames(all_metadata) <- make.unique(colnames(all_metadata))

# 3. Determine which sample identifier column exists
sample_col <- case_when(
  "Run" %in% colnames(all_metadata) ~ "Run",
  "Sample Name" %in% colnames(all_metadata) ~ "Sample Name",
  "Sample_Name" %in% colnames(all_metadata) ~ "Sample_Name",
  "BioSample" %in% colnames(all_metadata) ~ "BioSample",
  TRUE ~ colnames(all_metadata)[1]
)

cat(sprintf("Joining on metadata column: '%s'\n", sample_col))

# 4. Standardize the join column name to 'sample'
all_metadata <- all_metadata %>% 
  rename(sample = !!sym(sample_col)) %>% 
  mutate(sample = as.character(sample))

# Ensure sample in master_df is character
if (is.data.table(master_df)) {
  master_df[, sample := as.character(sample)]
} else {
  master_df$sample <- as.character(master_df$sample)
}

# 5. Join metadata on both study AND sample
if (is.data.table(master_df)) {
  setDT(all_metadata)
  final_df <- all_metadata[master_df, on = .(study, sample)]
} else {
  final_df <- master_df %>% 
    left_join(all_metadata, by = c("study", "sample"))
}

head(final_df)
```

## Make a Phyloseq Object

### tax table
```{r}
taxa <- final_df %>% 
  select(asv_id, 
         , domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species) %>% 
  distinct(asv_id, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "asv_id") %>% 
  as.matrix()
```

```{r}
head(taxa)
```
```{r}
TAX <- tax_table(taxa)
```


## otu table
```{r}
seqtab <- final_df %>% 
  select(asv_id, sample, count) %>%
  # Sum count values in case of any duplicate rows
  group_by(asv_id, sample) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(as.numeric(count), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = count, values_fill = 0)
```

```{r}
asv_names <- seqtab$asv_id
```

```{r}
otu_mat <- seqtab %>%
  select(-asv_id) %>%                  # Remove non-numeric ID column
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>% # Explicitly force numeric type
  as.matrix()

```

```{r}
rownames(otu_mat) <- asv_names
```

```{r}
OTU <- otu_table(otu_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
```


### Metadata table
```{r}

samp_df <- final_df %>% 
  select(sample, study, BioProject) %>% 
  distinct(sample, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "sample")
```

```{r}
head(samp_df)
```


```{r}
pig_raw_ps <- phyloseq(TAX,OTU, sample_data(samp_df))

```


## Working with the ps object

### Subsetting the ps object
```{r}
pig_ps <- subset_taxa(pig_raw_ps, domain != "NA")

```

```{r}

pig_ps <- subset_taxa(pig_ps, family != "Mitochondria")

```

```{r}

pig_ps <- subset_taxa(pig_ps, genus != "Chloroplast")

```




```{r}
#1. Merge ASVs to the Species level
ps_genus <- tax_glom(pig_ps, taxrank = "genus", NArm = TRUE)

# 2. Convert to Presence/Absence matrix (1 if count > 0, else 0)
pa_mat <- otu_table(ps_genus) > 0

# 3. Calculate how many samples each genra appears in
genus_prevalence <- rowSums(pa_mat)
total_samples <- nsamples(ps_genus)


```


```{r}
core_genra_ids <- names(genus_prevalence[genus_prevalence == total_samples])
```


## Using the master_df
```{r}
head(master_df, n = 3)
```


```{r}
clean_final_df <- final_df %>% 
  select(study, sample, domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species, count, asv_id)
```

```{r}
total_samples_count <- n_distinct(clean_final_df$sample)
```


```{r}
core_gen <- clean_final_df %>% 
  filter(count > 0) %>% 
  filter(genus != "" & genus != "NA") %>% 
  group_by(genus, family, order, class, phylum,domain) %>% 
  summarize(
    sample_count = n_distinct(sample),
    prevalence_pct = (sample_count/total_samples_count) * 100, 
    total_abundance = sum(count), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
core_fam <- clean_final_df %>% 
  filter(count > 0) %>% 
  filter(family != "" & family != "NA") %>% 
  group_by(family, order, class, phylum, domain) %>% 
  summarize(
    sample_count = n_distinct(sample),
    prevalence_pct = (sample_count/total_samples_count) * 100, 
    total_abundance = sum(count), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```
